#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

// Fast integer input
int fast_int() {
    int c = getchar();
    while (c != '-' && !isdigit(c)) c = getchar();
    int sign = 1;
    if (c == '-') {
        sign = -1;
        c = getchar();
    }
    int res = 0;
    while (isdigit(c)) {
        res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    }
    return res * sign;
}

int main() {
    int n = fast_int();
    if (n >= 12) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> a(n, vector<int>(5));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; ++j) {
            a[i][j] = fast_int();
        }
    }

    vector<int> ans;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        bool flag = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && flag; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n && flag; ++k) {
                if (i == j || j == k || k == i) continue;
                int sum = 0;
                for (int l = 0; l < 5; ++l) {
                    sum += (a[j][l] - a[i][l]) * (a[k][l] - a[i][l]);
                }
                if (sum > 0) {
                    flag = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (flag) {
            ans.push_back(i + 1);
        }
    }

    printf("%d\n", (int)ans.size());
    for (int idx : ans) {
        printf("%d\n", idx);
    }

    return 0;
}
